Purpose: Authoritative regression contract for processes AV Workstation Toolkit directly launches. This file documents boundaries and does not grant execution authority.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled AV Workstation Toolkit WPF App
Launches.Boundary: The in-process bootstrap supplies the embedded worker SHA-256. The compiled App can launch only that regular, hash-matched, product-identified worker at the exact packaged runtime path with a canonical correlated request.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled read-only inventory provider or compiled production worker
Launches.Boundary: The executable must be the registered Microsoft Desktop App Installer winget.exe beneath protected Program Files\WindowsApps with a valid Microsoft Authenticode signature. Inventory uses fixed read-only vectors. Production change actions are internally constructed Install/Update vectors for one exact reauthorized managed catalog package ID.
Used only for explicit Open logs and Show verified file actions. AV Workstation Toolkit does not execute the selected installer.
Used only for explicit operator requests to open catalogued official product or download pages.
Optional read-only snapshot collection only; not part of normal desktop startup.
